title: Name Not Found
story: The app cannot reach the database host db.internal. Pinging by IP works, by name does not.
goal: Fix /etc/resolv.conf so it points at the nameserver 10.0.0.2 instead of 10.0.0.99.

files./var/log/app.log: cannot resolve db.internal: no response from 10.0.0.99

hints: Which file lists the DNS server a Linux machine asks?
socratic: Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
